name: Ahijah
bio: Ahijah the Shilonite was a prophet who met Solomon's official Jeroboam alone in a field outside Jerusalem. Wearing a new cloak, Ahijah tore it into twelve pieces and told Jeroboam to take ten of them, declaring that the LORD was about to tear ten tribes of the kingdom away from Solomon and give them to Jeroboam, as judgment for Solomon's idolatry — though one tribe would remain with Solomon's son for David's sake. Ahijah promised that if Jeroboam obeyed the LORD as David had, the LORD would build him an enduring dynasty and give him Israel (1 Kings 11:29-39). Ahijah's prophecy set in motion the division of Solomon's kingdom, and his later dealings with Jeroboam are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
